actions.description: Standardize one molecular representation without generating 3D coordinates or optimizing geometry.
actions.input_description: structure: SMILES or a molecule/structure object

actions.description: Generate one explicit three-dimensional structure from a two-dimensional molecular representation.
actions.input_description: molecule: standardized SMILES or molecule object

actions.description: Generate a conformer ensemble; it does not perform the later quantum refinement or final ranking workflow.
actions.input_description: molecule plus optional initial_structure Artifact for CREST

actions.description: Rank and weight conformers only from aligned energies or free energies already supplied by the agent.
actions.input_description: ensemble and one aligned score record per conformer

actions.description: Repair missing biomolecular residues or atoms without choosing protonation, force field, solvent, or dynamics settings.
actions.input_description: biomolecular structure or workspace PDB Artifact

actions.description: Assign explicit protonation states using the agent-selected backend and pH/rule settings.
Assign named force-field or docking partial charges without parameterizing or solvating the system.
actions.input_description: structure with the desired protonation state already fixed

actions.description: Assign an explicitly selected force field to an already prepared molecular system.
actions.input_description: prepared structure plus optional ChargedStructure Artifact

actions.description: Build the explicitly requested solvent/ion environment without minimizing or propagating dynamics.
actions.input_description: ParameterizedSystem plus explicit box, solvent, and ion settings

actions.description: Calculate one molecular or non-periodic scalar energy with the exact software and method selected by the agent.
Calculate atomic forces for one non-periodic structure or an aligned batch.
actions.input_description: AtomicStructure or a homogeneous structure batch

actions.description: Calculate one molecular Hessian without deriving modes, spectra, or thermochemistry.
Optimize one non-periodic geometry and return the optimized structure only as the primary result.
actions.input_description: AtomicStructure plus explicit convergence and optional constraints

actions.description: Calculate one molecular dipole moment with an explicitly chosen electronic method.
Calculate electronic-structure population-analysis charges without attaching force-field parameters.
Calculate orbital energies, occupations, and optional coefficient artifacts.
Derive frequencies and normal modes from an existing Hessian and structure.
Construct an IR spectrum from vibration results that already contain intensities.
Derive thermochemical quantities from supplied electronic energy and frequencies; no optimization or Hessian is hidden.
actions.input_description: EnergyResult and FrequencyResult or a compatible parsed output Artifact

actions.description: Locate one candidate transition-state structure without automatically running frequencies or IRC.
actions.input_description: candidate structure and optional endpoint structures

actions.description: Trace an IRC from an already supplied transition-state structure.
Calculate an equilibrium composition/state for an explicitly supplied mechanism and thermodynamic condition.
Integrate one explicitly specified reaction network over time.
Solve one explicitly supplied microkinetic model without constructing the reaction model for the agent.
Minimize an already parameterized system without automatically equilibrating or propagating dynamics.
Propagate exactly one agent-defined dynamics segment and return its trajectory and final state.
Calculate an RMSD time series for an explicitly selected trajectory atom group and reference.
Calculate the radius-of-gyration time series for an explicitly selected atom group.
Calculate one radial distribution function for two explicitly selected atom groups.
Calculate one mean-squared-displacement time series for an explicitly selected atom group.
Evaluate explicitly defined collective variables on an existing trajectory.
Calculate one periodic-system energy with the explicitly selected electronic-structure backend.
actions.input_description: periodic AtomicStructure with cell and PBC

actions.description: Calculate periodic atomic forces for one structure or aligned displaced-structure batch.
actions.input_description: periodic AtomicStructure or homogeneous structure batch

actions.description: Calculate one periodic stress tensor without relaxing the structure.
Relax a periodic structure under explicit atomic/cell constraints.
actions.input_description: periodic AtomicStructure plus explicit relaxation controls

actions.description: Generate a displacement set from an explicit supercell matrix and displacement amplitude.
Assemble force constants only from a supplied displacement set and aligned forces.
Calculate a phonon dispersion from existing force constants and an explicit q-point path.
Calculate a phonon density of states from existing force constants and an explicit q mesh.
Dock an already prepared ligand into an already prepared receptor using an explicit search space.
actions.input_description: prepared receptor/ligand Artifacts and explicit box center/size

actions.description: Search PubChem compound records by an explicit identifier and namespace.
Search or retrieve RCSB PDB structure records using explicit identifiers or query terms.
Search Materials Project records by material id, formula, or explicit query fields.
actions.input_description: material id, formula, or structured query

actions.description: Search Catalysis-Hub reaction records using explicit reactant/product filters.
